name: cr604_3_nethergoyf_has_its_counted_toughness_in_the_library
why: CR 604.3: a characteristic-defining ability functions in every zone, and Nethergoyf's counts the card types in its owner's graveyard wherever it is: with three of them it is 3/4 in the library, so Recruiter of the Guard's 'toughness 2 or less' doesn't find it. Its printed toughness is 1.
